outcome.Summary: Implemented `jpath.Query` in jpath/jpath.go: a parser that turns a `$`-rooted path into steps (`.name`, `["key"]` with `\"`/`\\` escapes, `[N]` with negative indices, `[*]`/`.*`, `..name` recursive descent), and a stepwise evaluator where each step maps the current node list to a new one (missing keys/out-of-range indices/non-matching types yield nothing, not an error); recursive descent uses pre-order traversal with object children ordered by key, and star over objects sorts keys ascending. Malformed paths (e.g. `a.b`, `$.`, `$[`, `$[1`, `$["x]`, `$.1abc`, `$[abc]`) return a non-nil error and nil result; a no-match query returns an empty non-nil slice. Verified with the existing TestMember plus a new jpath/jpath_extra_test.go covering root, star, negative/out-of-range indices, quoted/escaped keys, recursive descent, empty-result semantics, and all malformed cases — `go test ./...` passes.
